# Handoff — proxy provider health + qwen rollout

Written 2026-08-05 ~18:15 UTC. Two independent threads: a **code PR** (ready but
ungated) and a **prod config rollout** (blocked, correctly, on a prerequisite PR).

Delete this file before opening the PR — it is scratch, not a deliverable.

---

## 1. Code: `feat/proxy-provider-health` (NOT committed, NOT pushed)

Worktree: `/Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/proxy-provider-health`

### What it does

Moves provider-health classification from the worker-response path to the
gateway proxy, and decides it on the **HTTP status** instead of by matching the
provider's prose. The user's instruction was explicit — *"why are you parsing
man, what's the point"* — and they then approved *"Yes — proxy owns it"*.

`packages/server/src/gateway/proxy/provider-health-status.ts` (new):

```
429 | 402       -> PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
401 | 403       -> PROVIDER_AUTH
everything else -> undefined (no health signal)
```

`secret-proxy.ts` calls it right after the upstream `fetch` (~line 1050), then
clears the error row on 2xx or writes `markInferenceProviderUnhealthy` with the
`Retry-After` header as the horizon. It swallows its own errors on purpose:
nothing routes on `inference_providers.status` today, so a failed health write
must not fail the user's inference call.

The **old path is deleted, not left alongside** (per the repo's no-shims rule):
- `recordProviderHealth` removed from `gateway/gateway/index.ts`
- `recordProviderSlug` removed from `agent-worker/src/gateway/gateway-integration.ts`
- the `HttpWorkerTransport` call removed from `agent-worker/src/runtime/worker.ts`
- `providerSlug` removed from `ThreadResponsePayload` in `core/src/types.ts`
- `agent-worker/src/__tests__/provider-slug-stamp.test.ts` deleted (it only
  covered the retired mechanism)

## 2. Prod: qwen rollout — **blocked, and correctly so**

### The finding that stopped it

I repointed one agent to `qwen/qwen3.8-max` and ran a real turn. It **never
reached qwen**. Prod log, `summaries-app-lobu-app-7466bcc94c-b5jxd`:

```
Creating dynamic model entry for gemini/qwen/qwen3.8-max (openai-completions)
Starting Lobu session: provider=openai, model=qwen/qwen3.8-max
Forwarding to upstream: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/chat/completions
Upstream returned 404 for POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/...
Worker execution failed: 404 status code (no body)
```

`session-runner.ts:928` logs `${rawProvider}/${modelId}` — so `rawProvider` was
**gemini** (the org default) and `modelId` was the whole string
`qwen/qwen3.8-max`. The `qwen/` prefix was never split off; the model went to
Google as a model name and 404'd.

**Confirmed contributing fact:** `origin/main`'s `config/providers.json` qwen
entry lists only `qwen-max, qwen-plus, qwen-turbo, qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct,
qwen2.5-72b-instruct` — **no `qwen3.8-max`** — and its `upstreamBaseUrl` is
`dashscope.aliyuncs.com`, not the Token Plan host.

**Not fully pinned:** I did not prove *why* an unknown model id causes provider
resolution to fall back to the org default rather than erroring. The catalog gap
is the leading candidate and the providers.json PR is clearly *necessary*;
whether it is *sufficient* must be re-tested after it deploys. Do not assume.

Worth knowing: `packages/agent-worker/src/runtime/model-resolver.ts` shows as
modified in the main checkout's working tree — the user may already be poking at
this exact area. Check with them before changing it.

### Prerequisite PR: `feat/qwen-3-8-max` (uncommitted)

Worktree: `/Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/qwen-3-8-max`
One file, `config/providers.json`:
- adds `qwen3.8-max` and `qwen3.8-max-preview` to the qwen models list
- amends `apiKeyInstructions` to name the Token Plan host

**Both model ids are real** — they are both in the user's working
`~/.pi/agent/auth.json` / models config. `review-fix` previously "corrected" this
by deleting `qwen3.8-max-preview`; that was wrong and was reverted. Do not let a
fixer delete it again.

Also recorded in memory: the providers.json group name must equal the capitalised
slug, and only the integration-vitest suite catches a mismatch.

### Current prod state (all verified by query, 18:13 UTC)

`inference_providers` rows named `qwen`:

|---|---|---|---|---|
| lobu-team | 16 | **false** | true | |
| atlas | 17 | **false** | true | |

| buremba | 19 | false | false | **soft-deleted** (`deleted_at` set) — was verification scaffolding |

I created 16/17/18 as `is_default=true` and then **unset it**, because a default
pointing at a model the deployed catalog can't resolve is a live hazard for any
agent without an explicit model pin. None of those orgs had a default before, so
`false` is the exact prior state. Re-set it deliberately after the catalog PR
ships, if wanted.

Upstream on 16/17/18 is the Token Plan host
`https://token-plan.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`, model
`qwen3.8-max`. Credentials went in through `lobu providers create` (so they are
properly encrypted into `agent_secrets`), keyed from `~/.pi/agent/auth.json`
→ `qwen.key`, passed as a `'$ENV_VAR'` reference so it never hit argv.

| lobu-team / Developer | `["z-ai/glm-5.2"]` | yes |

Only **4** actually route to z-ai today — only position `[0]` routes. The earlier

`buremba/personal-finance` was temporarily set to qwen for the test and is back

1. Ship `feat/qwen-3-8-max`.
2. After it deploys, re-run a real turn and confirm the log line reads

3. Only then repoint the 4 routing agents and soft-delete the 3 z-ai rows.

The Token Plan quota is a **5-hour bucket shared with their interactive `pi`

## 3. Verification mechanics learned (saves the next agent an hour)

- `lobu chat --org <other-org>` **403s** even for an org owner. `agent_users`
  ownership was *not* the cause — the row for `developer`/`lobu-team` already
  existed. An org-scoped PAT (`lobu token create --org`) did not help either.
  Chat works only in `buremba`, the CLI's active org. Root cause unresolved;
  see `verifyOwnedAgentAccess` in
  `packages/server/src/gateway/routes/shared/agent-ownership.ts` (it keys on
  `session.platform` + `resolveSettingsLookupUserId`).
- `lobu chat` **replays a buffered message** when the turn fails: it printed the
  *previous* turn's answer with an output timestamp 31s **older** than its own
  `connected` event. Never trust its stdout as proof a turn ran. Use `--json`
  and cross-check the prod pod logs.
- Prod CLI chat also hits
  `API SSE session ... not owned by this gateway instance; re-queueing` — the
  SSE connects to one replica while the run dispatches on another, so runs churn
  pending/completed. Expect noise.
- Ground truth for what a turn actually did:
  `kubectl logs -n summaries-prod summaries-app-lobu-app-<pod> --since=20m`,
  grepping for `Creating dynamic model entry` / `Forwarding to upstream`.
- The Chrome extension is **not connected**, so the browser path for UI proof is
  unavailable right now.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pre-review fixer: runs the reviewer CLI over the local diff with WRITE
# access and prompts/review-fix-prompt.md, so review-grade findings get fixed
# BEFORE `make review` posts a pi-review status. Posts nothing; commits
# nothing. The driving agent inspects the edits (shown at the end), commits,
# then runs `make review` once on the settled HEAD.
#
# Reviewer selection matches review.sh — REVIEWER_CLI=auto|codex|claude|pi. This
# step is mandated by AGENTS.md but is not a gate: unlike review.sh it posts no
# status, so a reviewer outage here silently skips the fixer instead of failing
# a check. Being hard-wired to one CLI therefore costs a whole quality pass
# whenever that CLI is unavailable, with nothing to signal it happened.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=scripts/lib/review-reviewer.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/review-reviewer.sh"

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

BASE_BRANCH="${BASE:-}"
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --base)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || { echo "usage: scripts/review-fix.sh [--base <branch>]" >&2; exit 2; }
      BASE_BRANCH="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      echo "usage: scripts/review-fix.sh [--base <branch>]" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done
if [ -z "$BASE_BRANCH" ]; then
  if git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main >/dev/null; then
    BASE_BRANCH="origin/main"
  else
    BASE_BRANCH="main"
  fi
fi

git rev-parse --verify --quiet "$BASE_BRANCH^{commit}" >/dev/null \
  || { echo ">> invalid base ref '$BASE_BRANCH'" >&2; exit 2; }
git merge-base "$BASE_BRANCH" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || { echo ">> no merge base between '$BASE_BRANCH' and HEAD" >&2; exit 2; }

PROMPT_FILE="prompts/review-fix-prompt.md"
[ -f "$PROMPT_FILE" ] || { echo ">> missing $PROMPT_FILE" >&2; exit 1; }

if git diff --quiet "$BASE_BRANCH...HEAD" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo ">> no diff against $BASE_BRANCH and no local changes; nothing to fix"
  exit 0

[ "$BUGS" -eq 0 ] || STATUS_REASONS+=("bugs>0")

[ "$SIMPLICITY" -ge "$PI_REVIEW_MIN_SIMPLICITY" ] || STATUS_REASONS+=("simplicity<$PI_REVIEW_MIN_SIMPLICITY")
[ "$BLOCKER_COUNT" -eq 0 ] || STATUS_REASONS+=("blockers>0")
[ "$TESTS_ADEQUATE" = "true" ] || STATUS_REASONS+=("tests inadequate")

  STATUS_STATE="failure"
  STATUS_DESCRIPTION="$HEADLINE; $(IFS=', '; echo "${STATUS_REASONS[*]}")"
else
  STATUS_DESCRIPTION="$HEADLINE"

check-drift:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - id: submodule
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-submodule
        with:
          deploy-key: ${{ secrets.OWLETTO_WEB_DEPLOY_KEY }}

      - name: Fork PR — fail if it modifies the submodule pointer, otherwise skip
        if: |
          steps.submodule.outputs.stubbed == 'true'
          && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
          && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # actions/checkout@v7 with default fetch-depth=1 only has the merge
          # commit; pull the two endpoints by SHA so ls-tree can resolve them.
          git fetch --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
          base_pointer=$(git ls-tree "$BASE_SHA" packages/owletto | awk '{print $3}')
          head_pointer=$(git ls-tree "$HEAD_SHA" packages/owletto | awk '{print $3}')
          if [ "$base_pointer" != "$head_pointer" ]; then
            echo "::error::Fork PRs cannot change the packages/owletto pointer."
            echo "  base: $base_pointer"
            echo "  head: $head_pointer"
            echo "Submodule bumps must come from a same-repo PR (deploy-key-authorized)."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "::notice::Fork PR with unchanged submodule pointer — drift check skipped."

      - name: Fail when deploy key is missing on a same-repo run
        if: |
          steps.submodule.outputs.stubbed == 'true'
          && !(github.event_name == 'pull_request'
            && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository)
        run: |
          echo "::error::OWLETTO_WEB_DEPLOY_KEY is missing for a same-repo run; drift check cannot run."
          exit 1

      - name: Check for unmerged non-bot commits on owletto/main
        if: steps.submodule.outputs.stubbed != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PINNED=$(git -C packages/owletto rev-parse HEAD)
          git -C packages/owletto fetch --quiet origin main
          REMOTE=$(git -C packages/owletto rev-parse origin/main)

          echo "Pinned (parent):   $PINNED"
          echo "owletto/main:  $REMOTE"

          # Hard rule: parent must never pin a SHA that isn't on owletto/main.
          # FluxCD reads charts from owletto/main; an off-main pin breaks deploy.
          if ! git -C packages/owletto merge-base --is-ancestor "$PINNED" origin/main; then
            echo "::error::Pinned SHA $PINNED is not reachable from owletto/main."
            echo "This violates the rule against pinning unmerged submodule SHAs (see AGENTS.md)."
            exit 1
          fi
